components.text: Sign in to the Bluesky account this connection should act as. This guide is for accounts hosted on bsky.social; accounts on another PDS are not supported by this bundle.

Open Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords and add a new app password for Ragentic. Do not use your main account password. Leave direct-message access off. You can revoke the app password at any time, which disconnects Ragentic.

Enter your handle (for example alice.bsky.social) or DID and the app password. Test creates a session at bsky.social and reads com.atproto.server.getSession; it posts nothing. Save encrypts the handle and app password after a successful Test; Ragentic renews the short-lived session token from them. Reading profiles, feeds and threads also works without an account at public.api.bsky.app.
Independent connector for Bluesky. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Bluesky.

atprotoSession.description: accessJwt from com.atproto.server.createSession with the account handle (or DID) and an app password. Ragentic's atproto_session credential creates and renews it.

info.description: Selected AT Protocol XRPC methods converted by Ragentic to OpenAPI 3.0 from the official lexicons of bluesky-social/atproto (pinned commit, MIT OR Apache-2.0). This is NOT an official Bluesky definition and is not endorsed by Bluesky Social PBC. Requests go to the account's PDS at https://bsky.social, which serves com.atproto.* itself and proxies app.bsky.* reads to the Bluesky AppView. The same app.bsky.* reads also work without authentication at https://public.api.bsky.app. Cross-lexicon object references are named (x-lexicon-ref / x-lexicon-union), not inlined.
info.title: Bluesky (AT Protocol) profiles, feeds, search and posting (independent conversion)

get.description: Get detailed profile view of an actor. Does not require auth, but contains relevant metadata with auth.

parameters.description: Handle or DID of account to fetch profile of.
parameters.name: actor

schema.description: Handle or DID of account to fetch profile of.

get.description: Find actors (profiles) matching search criteria. Does not require auth.

parameters.description: Search query string. Syntax, phrase, boolean, and faceting is unspecified, but Lucene query syntax is recommended.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search query string. Syntax, phrase, boolean, and faceting is unspecified, but Lucene query syntax is recommended.

get.description: Get a view of an actor's 'author feed' (post and reposts by the author). Does not require auth.

parameters.description: Combinations of post/repost types to include in response.
parameters.name: filter

schema.description: Combinations of post/repost types to include in response.

get.description: Get posts in a thread. Does not require auth, but additional metadata and filtering will be applied for authed requests.

parameters.description: How many levels of reply depth should be included in response.
parameters.name: depth

schema.description: How many levels of reply depth should be included in response.

parameters.description: How many levels of parent (and grandparent, etc) post to include.
parameters.name: parentHeight

schema.description: How many levels of parent (and grandparent, etc) post to include.

thread.description: One of: app.bsky.feed.defs#threadViewPost, app.bsky.feed.defs#notFoundPost, app.bsky.feed.defs#blockedPost (identified by $type).

get.description: Find posts matching search criteria, returning views of those posts. Note that this API endpoint may require authentication (eg, not public) for some service providers and implementations.

parameters.description: Search query string; syntax, phrase, boolean, and faceting is unspecified, but Lucene query syntax is recommended.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search query string; syntax, phrase, boolean, and faceting is unspecified, but Lucene query syntax is recommended.

parameters.description: Specifies the ranking order of results.
parameters.name: sort

schema.description: Specifies the ranking order of results.

parameters.description: Filter results for posts after the indicated datetime (inclusive). Expected to use 'sortAt' timestamp, which may not match 'createdAt'. Can be a datetime, or just an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).
parameters.name: since

schema.description: Filter results for posts after the indicated datetime (inclusive). Expected to use 'sortAt' timestamp, which may not match 'createdAt'. Can be a datetime, or just an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.description: Filter results for posts before the indicated datetime (not inclusive). Expected to use 'sortAt' timestamp, which may not match 'createdAt'. Can be a datetime, or just an ISO date (YYY-MM-DD).
parameters.name: until

schema.description: Filter results for posts before the indicated datetime (not inclusive). Expected to use 'sortAt' timestamp, which may not match 'createdAt'. Can be a datetime, or just an ISO date (YYY-MM-DD).

parameters.description: Filter to posts which mention the given account. Handles are resolved to DID before query-time. Only matches rich-text facet mentions.
parameters.name: mentions

schema.description: Filter to posts which mention the given account. Handles are resolved to DID before query-time. Only matches rich-text facet mentions.

parameters.description: Filter to posts by the given account. Handles are resolved to DID before query-time.
parameters.name: author

schema.description: Filter to posts by the given account. Handles are resolved to DID before query-time.

parameters.description: Filter to posts in the given language. Expected to be based on post language field, though server may override language detection.
parameters.name: lang

schema.description: Filter to posts in the given language. Expected to be based on post language field, though server may override language detection.

parameters.description: Filter to posts with URLs (facet links or embeds) linking to the given domain (hostname). Server may apply hostname normalization.
parameters.name: domain

schema.description: Filter to posts with URLs (facet links or embeds) linking to the given domain (hostname). Server may apply hostname normalization.

parameters.description: Filter to posts with links (facet links or embeds) pointing to this URL. Server may apply URL normalization or fuzzy matching.
parameters.name: url

schema.description: Filter to posts with links (facet links or embeds) pointing to this URL. Server may apply URL normalization or fuzzy matching.

parameters.description: Filter to posts with the given tag (hashtag), based on rich-text facet or tag field. Do not include the hash (#) prefix. Multiple tags can be specified, with 'AND' matching.
parameters.name: tag

schema.description: Filter to posts with the given tag (hashtag), based on rich-text facet or tag field. Do not include the hash (#) prefix. Multiple tags can be specified, with 'AND' matching.

parameters.description: Optional pagination mechanism; may not necessarily allow scrolling through entire result set.
parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: Optional pagination mechanism; may not necessarily allow scrolling through entire result set.

hitsTotal.description: Count of search hits. Optional, may be rounded/truncated, and may not be possible to paginate through all hits.

post.description: Create a single new repository record. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

collection.description: The NSID of the record collection.

record.description: The record itself; must contain $type. For a post use collection app.bsky.feed.post and this shape (lexicon app.bsky.feed.post).

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.

embed.description: One of: app.bsky.embed.images, app.bsky.embed.video, app.bsky.embed.gallery, app.bsky.embed.external, app.bsky.embed.record, app.bsky.embed.recordWithMedia (identified by $type).

facets.description: Annotations of text (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc)

labels.description: Self-label values for this post. Effectively content warnings. One of: com.atproto.label.defs#selfLabels (identified by $type).

langs.description: Indicates human language of post primary text content.

tags.description: Additional hashtags, in addition to any included in post text and facets.

text.description: The primary post content. May be an empty string, if there are embeds.

repo.description: The handle or DID of the repo (aka, current account).

swapCommit.description: Compare and swap with the previous commit by CID.

validate.description: Can be set to 'false' to skip Lexicon schema validation of record data, 'true' to require it, or leave unset to validate only for known Lexicons.

post.summary: Create a record (for example a post)

post.description: Delete a repository record, or ensure it doesn't exist. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

collection.description: The NSID of the record collection.

repo.description: The handle or DID of the repo (aka, current account).

swapCommit.description: Compare and swap with the previous commit by CID.

swapRecord.description: Compare and swap with the previous record by CID.

post.description: Upload a new blob, to be referenced from a repository record. The blob will be deleted if it is not referenced within a time window (eg, minutes). Blob restrictions (mimetype, size, etc) are enforced when the reference is created. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

requestBody.description: Raw blob bytes; set Content-Type to the blob's MIME type. Size limits are set by the PDS.

blob.description: Blob reference: {$type: blob, ref: {$link: CID}, mimeType, size}.

post.summary: Upload a blob (image or video) for a record

get.description: Get information about the current auth session. Requires auth.

status.description: If active=false, this optional field indicates a possible reason for why the account is not active. If active=false and no status is supplied, then the host makes no claim for why the repository is no longer being hosted.

spec.description: Connect to Bluesky (AT Protocol) with an independent Ragentic integration: read profiles, feeds, threads and search, and post with an app password. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Bluesky.
spec.title: Bluesky

provenance.normalization: Ragentic conversion of the pinned lexicons listed in origins to OpenAPI 3.0 (drafts/bluesky/build via drafts/build.py); queries become GET /xrpc/<nsid>, procedures POST; cross-lexicon refs named, not inlined. Not an official definition.

external_references: Requires Ragentic's atproto_session credential type (ragentic-io/ragentic PR on branch feat/social-connectors-catalog); older Ragentic servers reject this bundle's setup.
